name: P-013 workload C (4-step program, conditional gate, stable step ids, no model call): coord-program DBOS workflow (control) vs blueprint execution program (candidate), D-016 matrix, 5 process-isolated repetitions
testBlobNote: The C test file blob differs from the 2026-09-28 08:xxZ baseline runs (c-run2/test-blob.txt: f8ba03fc -> 4c46e545); comparisons against the baseline evidence cross that test-file change.
command: for k in 0..4: P013_MATRIX=1 P013_DEDICATED_PG=native P013_MODES=warm,cold P013_CONCURRENCIES=1,8 P013_WARMUPS=20 P013_WARM_SAMPLES=200 P013_COLD_SAMPLES=50 P013_REPETITIONS=1 P013_REPETITION_OFFSET=$k PAPERCUSP_TEST_FILE_TIMEOUT_MS=3600000 npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/blueprint/operation-performance-c.integration.test.ts (.papercusp/scratch/p013-fleet/c-matrix.sh)
rig: Dedicated native PostgreSQL cluster per repetition (libs/test-config/src/dedicated-native-pg.ts), exclusive p013-benchmark-rig resource lock held for the whole matrix; deterministic tool steps on both arms (no model call); coord-program WorkflowQueue min polling 50ms (D-025) so the control arm is not penalised by the DBOS 1000ms default.
notProven: Invariants (zero harness_plans / plan_runs rows on both arms, stable step ids across every sample, no duplicated step effects) are asserted inside the test per repetition (all 5 passed); they are not re-derived here.
Persistence counters are dedicated-cluster pg_stat deltas per sample; they attribute cost to the whole cluster, not to a specific table.
